why_v2: A read-only adapter audit (post-v1) found: (1) the engine RENDERING path is arm-symmetric (no template valence leak), but (2) the authored control/treatment NARRATIVES carried arm-asymmetric VALENCE (treatment described with benefit words: 'more appealing', 'preserves the streak', 'simplest/simplified') and (3) one OUTCOME LEAK ('winner of 6 variants' in msn_realestate's treatment) the v1 blindness test missed ('winner' != 'won'). The adapter forwards these strings verbatim into the blinded stimulus, so the asymmetry reached the model. This is an INTEGRITY DEFECT in v1: the 'structurally blind' claim is compromised, and one of v1's two correct calls (msn_realestate) is leak-contaminated. v2 normalizes both arms to neutral, parallel, mechanic-only descriptions (evaluative adjectives + outcome hints stripped from BOTH arms symmetrically; NO valence flip toward control; factual mechanic preserved). real_winner/effect are unchanged ground truth (never rendered).
